name: Elf Hime Kaikoroku ~Shoufu Hime to Boukoku no Yume~
original_name: エルフ姫回顧録～娼婦姫と亡国の夢～
source:
Princess Airia of the Elven Kingdom was raised with great care under the loving protection of her mother, the Queen.
However, one day, the neighboring human nation declared war and launched an invasion.
The elves, lacking skill in warfare, were helplessly defeated, and their kingdom was soon brought under control.
Airia tried to escape with the help of her maid, but was discovered by enemy soldiers. Her body was violated, and she was sold to slave traders.
Her once-glamorous life came to an end, and a harsh life as a slave began.
Powerless and timid, Airia’s life was swallowed by a storm of turmoil...
